You are Hermes Agent, an intelligent AI assistant created by Nous Research. You are helpful, knowledgeable, and direct. You assist users with a wide range of tasks including answering questions, writing and editing code, analyzing information, creative work, and executing actions via your tools. You communicate clearly, admit uncertainty when appropriate, and prioritize being genuinely useful over being verbose unless otherwise directed below. Be targeted and efficient in your exploration and investigations.

Conversation started: Saturday, April 18, 2026 08:45 PM
Model: MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed
Provider: minimax-cn

You are on Weixin/WeChat. Markdown formatting is supported, so you may use it when it improves readability, but keep the message compact and chat-friendly. You can send media files natively: include MEDIA:/absolute/path/to/file in your response. Images are sent as native photos, videos play inline when supported, and other files arrive as downloadable documents. You can also include image URLs in markdown format ![alt](url) and they will be downloaded and sent as native media when possible.

messages.content:
Research the 2026 IE Expo China (环博会) market trends, technology trends, and policy drivers. 

Context: We have OCR data of ~972 exhibitors from the 2026 IE Expo (Environmental Expo) in Shanghai, April 13-15, 2026 at Shanghai New International Expo Center. The data shows:
- 86 instrumentation/sensor companies (E4 hall dominant)
- 39 digital/cloud platform companies with keywords like 云/平台/系统/数据/智能
- 69 water treatment/pump/valve companies
- Large number of air treatment companies (E5/E6 halls)
- About 30 environmental engineering/water investment companies

I need you to research and summarize publicly available information about:
1. China's "十五五" (15th Five-Year Plan) environmental monitoring priorities and key directives
2. Current trends in environmental monitoring technology (online monitoring, IoT, cloud platforms, AI applications)
3. Customer demand trends in water treatment and environmental monitoring market (municipal vs industrial)
4. Key product and technology trends visible at environmental expos
5. Market drivers and policy tailwinds for environmental monitoring in China 2025-2026

Use web search to find relevant information. Focus on facts from official/government sources, industry reports, and credible media.

Please provide a structured summary I can use to create a market intelligence PPT.

I'll research the IE Expo China market trends, technology trends, and policy drivers using web searches. Let me start by gathering information on each topic area.
<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="web_search">
<parameter name="query">中国十五五环境监测规划 政策 2025 2026</parameter>
<parameter name="limit">10</parameter>
<parameter name="search_after">2025-04-01</parameter>
</invoke>
<invoke name="web_search">
<parameter name="query">IE Expo China 2026 环博会 环保展</parameter>
<parameter name="limit">10</parameter>
<parameter name="search_after">2026-01-01</parameter>
</invoke>
<invoke name="web_search">
<parameter name="query">中国环境监测市场趋势 2025 传感器 在线监测 IoT</parameter>
<parameter name="limit">10</parameter>
<parameter name="search_after">2025-01-01</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
